* strengthening the company’s positions in the production and sale of safe glass packaging; * continuous improvement of its performance in relation to the environment; * ensuring and maintaining healthy and safe working conditions; * continuous improvement of energy efficiency, efficient use of energy resources, encouragement the deployment of innovative technologies, equipment and processes that save energy; * ensuring the continuity of production and trade with glass packaging. * our product safety management system ensures controlled conditions under which hazards to the product and respectively to the food for which it is intended are identified, assessed and controlled in such a way that the products produced could not cause harm directly or indirectly to the final consumer. * delivery of the best and safest possible product, within the requirements of customers, observing the rules of good production and hygiene practices, which in turn guarantee the safety of the product, respectively food and the health of consumers. * promoting and building a product safety culture in the organization by providing training: Improves communication at all levels of the organization and evaluates achievements in terms of safety and quality of manufactured products. * provide the resources and information necessary to achieve the objectives; * manage the activities within the scope of each of the implemented systems, in accordance with the applicable legislation and all commitments, as well as in accordance with international management standards; * manage environmental protection, including pollution prevention in terms of efficient waste management, use of appropriate technologies and equipment with minimal negative impact on the environment, sustainable use of resources; * creates conditions for managing health and safety at work, preventing injuries, illnesses and accidents; * creates conditions for staff awareness of the principles, policies and objectives of the management systems by providing motivation, training and qualification; * manage the use of available material, human and financial resources in a way that ensures the efficient functioning of processes and increases the quality and safety of products; * works to build mutual trust with customers by satisfying their requirements, based on the correctness, quality and safety of the offered glass packaging; * maintains relationships with suppliers, guaranteeing high quality of collaboration; * effective use of available resources and in accordance with the requirements, needs and needs of stakeholders: + introducing new methods for risk analysis and assessment; + methods for hazard forecasting; + optimization of processes – adequacy, expediency, quality awareness; + control and reduction of the negative impact on the environment during the implementation of processes; * maintaining a system for safe production and quality control and critical points in the food production process and compliance with regulations. * clearly delegated responsibilities to staff in the organization. This policy must be implemented, maintained, disseminated, and made it accessible and understandable to all. The commitment of all employees of the company, in accordance with the objectives, through knowledge of the requirements for compliance with internationally recognized quality management standards; customer requirements, as well as all legal and regulatory requirements applicable to our sector.
